purpose: Development-only queries for calibrating the semantic evidence gate. They are written for calibration, are not the R8 acceptance inputs, and must not be replaced by them. Held-out evaluation remains TJ's separate suite.
corpus: fixtures/documents (the same 15 synthetic documents as R8)
calibrationRule: GATE_MIN_MARGIN and GATE_MIN_TOP_COSINE are each chosen as the value that maximizes related passes minus unrelated passes on these queries; when the two sets separate this is any value between them, and ties are resolved toward the lower value by taking the lowest three-decimal value in the maximizing interval. Both are recorded with the run that produced them.
